title: Name on the Manifest
description: The sidebar's footer is the one place every logged-in page quietly tells you who you are and what you're allowed to do. Confirm it's accurate for all four roles, not just the one everyone tests with.
successCondition: For each of the four seeded roles, after logging in the sidebar footer displays text matching the pattern "<role> · <email>" with the exact role name (admin, dispatcher, driver, or customer) and the exact email used to log in — checked for all four roles in the same test run, not just one.
hints: The footer sits at the bottom of the left nav, above the "log out" button, inside NavShell.tsx.
Log out fully (click the log out button, don't just navigate away) between role switches so no stale session bleeds into the next check.
